content_html:
From Blygger

(1) the technical design values of Blygger seem very old-school, Web 1.0 (not meant as criticism or praise, just an observation). No more centralized platforms, everybody acts as their own publisher of static content, the way Tim B-L would have wanted it.

Not wrong, though it’s mostly an imported value from the static-site wave, since at this point blygger kinda needs to piggyback on static sites. I don’t personally have strong Web1 nostalgia. But if Threads can talk ActivityPub I guess anything is possible?

The other lineage is also old —- trans lesion is Ted Nelson values. Versioning-fu is Git-over-Subversion values.

Also — the stubs I’m building in for AI and crypto make it future-forward too. It’s a bit all over the place.
